Thanks for the context. I reviewed the ask and the draft margin model Grace referenced. Decision: approve up to 20% onboarding credit applied as a one-time contra credit to the first invoice, subject to the following conditions:

1) Customer signs a 12-month committed starter package (minimum committed spend as per the redline workbook).
2) Credit must be documented in Schedule A (onboarding credit clause) and explicitly marked as non-recurring; do NOT reduce list prices or create a recurring discount line.
3) Include a 30-day performance SLO in the MAP; if we experience obvious misuse (fraudulent consumption patterns) credit is void.
4) Finance to apply the credit in billing as an invoice-level adjustment and flag in Salesforce/HubSpot with tag "exec-credit-SEP27".

Grace — please confirm you and Legal can produce the one-paragraph amendment for Schedule A. Monica — please work with Billing to ensure the credit flow is a contra invoice entry (not a rate change).

Ben — proceed to customer and attach the DocuSign link once Legal confirms amendment language. Keep the offer time-limited (7 days).

Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
